model.intended_use: Research decision-support component for short-horizon hemodynamic trend forecasting from patient-monitor waveforms. Not an autonomous diagnostic or treatment-prescribing device.
model.calibration_source: validation splits only - synthetic: 140 patients; real: 25 VitalDB validation cases

A.name: Integrated Deterioration Alert & Intervention Response Monitor
A.inputs: ECG, PPG, invasive ABP, intervention events
A.setting: ICU / operating room with an arterial line

B.name: Non-Invasive Early Warning Tool
B.inputs: ECG and PPG only (no arterial line)
B.setting: Step-down unit, recovery area, lower-resource monitoring

C.name: Clinician Decision Support Review System
combines: Concept 5 - Clinician decision support review system
C.inputs: Stored ECG, PPG, ABP and intervention records
